rundown: Go-Go beat Nets 108-100 at CareFirst Arena in Washington, DC in front of 153. Go-Go led 64-55 at the half and never looked back.
Leading the way — Nets: Chaney Johnson 22 pts; Ben Saraf 10 ast; Drake Powell 7 reb. Go-Go: Alondes Williams 24 pts, 7 ast; Felix Okpara 13 reb.
Where Go-Go won it: they shot 48% to 46%, shot 38% from three to 29% and won the boards 44-39.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 24, 1:56 PM ET. It had Nets 79% and Go-Go 21%, projecting Nets 106.8 – Go-Go 97.4 (204.2 total, Nets by 9.4).

Final: Nets 100 – Go-Go 108. Wrong winner: it had Nets at 79%, and Go-Go (21%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Nets came in with a 10% above average attack and a 7% leakier than average defense (4-2, 116.3 scored and 109.7 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 11 and 11 games of evidence. Projected to score 106.8, they scored 100 (−6.8 points, 6% under); projected to allow 97.4, they allowed 108 (+10.6 points, 11% over).

Go-Go came in with a 3% above average attack and a 7% leakier than average defense (0-6, 103.2 scored and 119.2 allowed a game over 6 games), worth about 12 and 12 games of evidence. Projected to score 97.4, they scored 108 (+10.6 points, 11% over); projected to allow 106.8, they allowed 100 (−6.8 points, 6% under).

The bigger miss was Go-Go's scoring (+10.6 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 208 against 204.2 projected (+3.8), about the 59th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Go-Go by 8 against Nets by 9.4 projected, about the 93rd percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.038 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +16.2 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 111 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.019 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Nets attack ×0.989, defense ×0.981 (6 games); Go-Go attack ×0.974, defense ×1.000 (7 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 17.4 points), no bet.
